description: This file contains unit tests for the delayed queue rebalancing functionality in an Orleans streaming setup using Azure Queue streams. It defines a test class with multiple test methods that validate the behavior of the system during queue rebalancing and cluster scaling scenarios, including configuration setup and resource cleanup.

classes.name: DelayedQueueRebalancingTests
classes.description: A test class for validating Azure Queue stream provider's delayed queue rebalancing in Orleans.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the client to use a static gateway list with a single gateway.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo hosting Azure Queue streams, including cluster options and storage.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides test cluster configuration to set initial silos and add configurator.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up Azure queues after tests are run.

methods.name: DelayedQueueRebalancingTests_1
methods.description: Test method that validates queue rebalancing after a delay when no silos are added.

methods.name: DelayedQueueRebalancingTests_2
methods.description: Test method that validates queue rebalancing after adding silos dynamically.

methods.name: ValidateAgentsState
methods.description: Helper method to verify the number of silos and agents matches the expected counts.
